title: Purchasing Note: Grille and Hardware Insert Reorders on Late-Signed Factory Production Orders
content:
**Note.** For Factory Production Orders whose acknowledgment came in late, insert and hardware reordering adds business days to the late-acknowledgment shift as well: a grilles-between-glass change order on the window contract the order builds adds **2 business days**, a hardware finish change order without any grilles-between-glass change order adds **1 business day**, and neither adds nothing.

The days are added to the late-acknowledgment shift as whole business days before the late-acknowledgment revised ship date is counted.

## Records read

The change orders are those on the Window Replacement Contracts contract that the factory order builds, by their kind: grilles between glass, or hardware finish. Any number of change orders of one kind counts the same as one.

## Truth table

| Grilles-between-glass change order on the contract | Hardware finish change order on the contract | Days added |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 2 |
| yes | no | 2 |
| no | yes | 1 |
| no | no | none |

## Hypothetical cases

- A contract with two hardware finish change orders and no grilles-between-glass change order: 1 business day.
- A contract with one grilles-between-glass change order and one hardware finish change order: 2 business days; the hardware finish line adds nothing further.
